secondary_photo: 老房子爱好者，2022年刊图《山阴路上的优秀历史保护建筑和名人故居》，图注山阴路209弄3–4号，拍摄时间未载。
first_projection: The equivalent focal length of 33 mm across 2144 pixels with principal point (1072,712) gives f=1965.33 px. The front plane is defined by the upper middle window and the landing at native image ordinate 1130.
front_eaves: 131 native contrast edges in the first exposure and 62 in the second constrain the overhang. The second camera recovers the line within 0.95 px RMS.
main_pitch: The lower flashing of each dormer meets the main plane. Front-face triangulation and the registered eave give approximately 28.5° from the left and 29–30° from the right. Construction uses 29°.
rear_constraint: The sky observed between the dormers in the second photograph rules out a raised rear ridge closer than about 9.5 local units. The display puts the high tile edge at 10.1. The unseen reverse pitch is outside the exhibit.
limits: Original documents do not establish absolute site elevations, full rear plan, original tile colour, or the use and construction of the three longitudinal dark roof strips.
